_about: Recall relevance benchmark corpus (BENCH-1). Two labelled corpora from the 2026-10-17 evaluation: recall (145 memories over 5 fictitious projects, 83 queries: 62 with a stored answer, 17 topically adjacent negatives and 4 off-topic ones) and agentsim (62 memories written by a simulated agent over 21 sessions, 40 future-session tasks). Vectors for every text are frozen in vectors.json (bge-m3); regenerate with generate-vectors.mjs.

memories.label: L.runtime.node20
memories.title: payments-api
memories.body: ledgerly: payments-api is a Node 20 Fastify service backed by Postgres 15.

memories.label: L.kafka.dropped
memories.title: ledgerly: drop Kafka for payments-api events; use a Postgres transactional outbox polled by billing-worker
memories.body: We dropped Kafka for ledgerly's payments-api domain events. Rationale: the team is two engineers and could not operate a Kafka cluster on-call; the outbox gives exactly-once publication inside the same Postgres transaction as the payment write. Alternatives considered: Kafka on MSK (ops burden), SQS (no ordering per merchant). Chosen: transactional outbox table payments_outbox polled by billing-worker every 2s.

memories.label: L.money.cents
memories.text: ledgerly: payments-api stores all money amounts as integer minor units (cents) in bigint columns, never as floats.

memories.label: L.owner.marta
memories.text: ledgerly: Marta Ruiz owns the billing domain (billing-worker and invoices) and approves schema changes to invoice tables.

memories.label: U.pref.vitest
memories.text: Nico prefers Vitest over Jest for TypeScript projects.

memories.label: T.expo51
memories.text: tidepool: the Tidepool mobile app is built with Expo SDK 51 and React Native 0.74.

memories.label: T.zustand
memories.title: tidepool: use Zustand instead of Redux Toolkit for client state in the mobile app
memories.body: Chosen Zustand for the Tidepool mobile app's client state. Rationale: the stores are small, and Redux Toolkit's boilerplate (slices, provider, typed hooks) slowed down onboarding of the two new mobile devs. Server state stays in TanStack Query. Alternatives considered: Redux Toolkit, Jotai.

memories.label: T.folders
memories.text: tidepool: mobile app code is organized by feature folders under src/features/<feature>, each with its own components, hooks and api files.

memories.label: T.sofia
memories.text: tidepool: Sofía Lind is the design lead and signs off on any new screen in the mobile app before it ships.

memories.label: A.cdc.redpanda
memories.text: atlas: Atlas ingests change data capture from the core Postgres databases through Debezium into a Kafka-compatible Redpanda cluster.

memories.label: A.dbt.naming
memories.text: atlas: dbt staging models are prefixed stg_, intermediate models int_, and marts are named fct_ or dim_.

memories.label: A.priya

memories.text: ledgerly: payments-api deploys to Fly.io through the GitHub Actions workflow deploy.yml (fly deploy) on every merge to main.

memories.label: L.deploy.approval
memories.text: ledgerly: production deploys of payments-api need a manual approval from the #payments-oncall rotation in the GitHub environment 'production'.

memories.label: L.fly.migration
memories.text: ledgerly: fly deploy of payments-api fails with 'release command failed' when a migration runs longer than 60s; long migrations must run first on a one-off Fly machine.

memories.text: tidepool: end-to-end tests for the mobile app use Detox running on the iOS simulator in CI.

memories.text: tidepool: mobile releases are built and submitted with EAS Build and EAS Submit; production builds use the 'production' profile in eas.json.

memories.text: tidepool: unit tests in the mobile app use Jest via the jest-expo preset, not Vitest, because the Expo preset only supports Jest.

memories.label: A.snowflake
memories.text: atlas: the Atlas warehouse is Snowflake, database ANALYTICS, with one schema per dbt layer.

memories.label: A.dbt.deploy
memories.text: atlas: dbt changes deploy by merging to main; CI runs dbt build --select state:modified+ against a zero-copy Snowflake clone before the production job runs.

memories.label: A.airflow.parse
memories.text: atlas: Airflow DAG files must not import dbt at module level, because the MWAA scheduler times out parsing DAGs that take longer than 30 seconds.

memories.label: L.bug.doublecharge
memories.text: ledgerly: payments-api double-charged customers on client retries because the idempotency key was looked up globally instead of per merchant; fixed by scoping the unique index to (merchant_id, idempotency_key).

memories.label: L.stripe.2024
memories.text: ledgerly: the Stripe API version for payments-api is pinned to 2024-06-20 in the Stripe client config.

memories.label: U.pref.regression
memories.text: Nico wants every bugfix PR to include a regression test that reproduces the bug before the fix.

memories.label: T.bug.fcm
memories.text: tidepool: Android push notifications stopped arriving because the mobile app still used the legacy FCM server key; fixed by migrating to FCM HTTP v1 with a service-account JSON uploaded to EAS credentials.

memories.label: T.prebuild
memories.text: tidepool: running expo prebuild deletes manual edits in the android/ folder; native changes must go through config plugins in app.config.ts.

memories.label: A.dagster.why
memories.title: atlas: migrate Atlas orchestration from Airflow on MWAA to Dagster
memories.body: Decision for the Atlas data platform: move orchestration from Airflow 2.7 on MWAA to Dagster. Rationale: Dagster's software-defined assets give column-level lineage that Airflow lacks, local development works without a scheduler, and MWAA cost about 1,900 USD/month for idle environments. Alternatives considered: staying on MWAA with Cosmos for dbt, Prefect. Dagster won on dbt asset integration.

memories.label: A.bug.refunds
memories.text: atlas: fct_orders double-counted refunds because stg_refunds did not deduplicate Debezium update events; fixed by keeping the latest event per refund_id with qualify row_number().

memories.label: L.bug.webhook
memories.text: ledgerly: Stripe webhook signature verification in payments-api failed because Fastify parsed the JSON body before verification; the webhook route must read the raw body (addContentTypeParser with parseAs buffer).

memories.label: L.money.cents#2
memories.text: ledgerly: payments-api keeps money as integer cents in bigint columns, not floating point.

memories.label: L.runtime.node22
memories.text: ledgerly: payments-api was upgraded to Node 22 LTS.

memories.label: T.e2e.maestro
memories.text: tidepool: mobile end-to-end tests now use Maestro instead of Detox, because Detox was flaky on the Android emulator in CI; Maestro flows live in .maestro/.

memories.label: U.pref.smallpr
memories.text: Nico prefers small pull requests of under 400 changed lines.

memories.label: A.dagster
memories.text: atlas: Atlas pipelines now run on Dagster Cloud with a hybrid agent on EKS; Airflow on MWAA was decommissioned.

memories.label: A.retention
memories.text: atlas: Redpanda topic retention for Atlas CDC topics is 7 days.

memories.label: U.pref.ruff
memories.text: Nico prefers Python code formatted with ruff format and linted with ruff, not black or flake8.

memories.label: L.deploy.argocd
memories.text: ledgerly: payments-api no longer deploys to Fly.io; since the October migration it deploys to the shared EKS cluster through ArgoCD, which syncs the payments-api Helm chart from the infra-gitops repo.

memories.label: L.deploy.howto
memories.text: ledgerly: to deploy payments-api, bump the image tag in infra-gitops/apps/payments-api/values-prod.yaml and let ArgoCD sync; there is no manual fly deploy anymore.

memories.label: L.rename.invoicing
memories.text: ledgerly: billing-worker was renamed to invoicing-worker; the Kubernetes deployment, the Docker image and the Datadog service tag all use the name invoicing-worker.

memories.label: L.pg16
memories.text: ledgerly: payments-api runs Postgres 16 on RDS after the October upgrade from Postgres 15.

memories.label: T.expo52
memories.text: tidepool: the mobile app was upgraded to Expo SDK 52 and React Native 0.76 with the New Architecture enabled.

memories.label: T.ken
memories.text: tidepool: Ken Ito owns mobile QA and runs the release checklist before every App Store and Play Store submission.

memories.label: T.e2e.detox#2
memories.text: tidepool: Detox is used for the mobile app's end-to-end tests on the iOS simulator.

memories.label: A.dagster.deploy
memories.text: atlas: Dagster code locations for Atlas deploy through the GitHub Actions workflow dagster-deploy.yml, which builds the image and runs dagster-cloud deployment update.

memories.label: A.terraform
memories.text: atlas: Atlas production infrastructure (Snowflake roles, Dagster agent, Redpanda) is managed with Terraform in the atlas-infra repo, and terraform apply runs only through the Atlantis bot on PR comments.

memories.label: A.dbt18
memories.text: atlas: the Atlas dbt project was upgraded from dbt-core 1.7 to dbt-core 1.8.

memories.label: L.owner.diego
memories.text: ledgerly: Diego Ferrer took over ownership of the billing domain (invoicing-worker and invoices) from Marta Ruiz in October; schema changes to invoice tables now need Diego's approval.

memories.label: L.stripe.2025
memories.text: ledgerly: the Stripe API version for payments-api was bumped to 2025-03-31 in the Stripe client config.

memories.label: L.kafka.msk
memories.text: ledgerly: Kafka (Amazon MSK) was reintroduced only for the analytics export of payment events; the Postgres transactional outbox is still the mechanism for billing events.

memories.label: T.ota
memories.text: tidepool: JS-only hotfixes for the mobile app ship as OTA updates with EAS Update on the 'production' channel; native changes still require a store build.

memories.label: T.apiurl
memories.text: tidepool: the mobile app's API base URL comes from app.config.ts extra.apiUrl, set per EAS build profile.

memories.label: T.zustand#2
memories.text: tidepool: client state in the mobile app is managed with Zustand stores.

memories.label: A.tomas
memories.text: atlas: Tomás Vega replaced Priya Nair as the data platform lead and now owns the Snowflake warehouse cost budget.

memories.label: A.wh
memories.text: atlas: the Snowflake warehouse TRANSFORM_WH is sized MEDIUM with auto-suspend at 60 seconds to control cost.

memories.label: L.owner.marta#2
memories.text: ledgerly: Marta Ruiz approves schema changes to invoice tables.

memories.label: L.deploy.argocd#2
memories.text: ledgerly: payments-api is deployed by ArgoCD from the infra-gitops repo.

memories.label: L.runbook
memories.text: ledgerly: the payments-api on-call runbook lives in Notion under Payments > Runbooks > payments-api.

memories.label: T.deeplinks
memories.text: tidepool: deep links use the scheme tidepool:// and universal links on links.tidepool.app, handled by expo-router.

memories.label: U.pref.conventional
memories.text: Nico wants commit messages to follow the Conventional Commits format.

memories.label: A.dagster#2
memories.text: atlas: Atlas uses Dagster for pipeline orchestration.

memories.label: A.backfill
memories.text: atlas: Dagster backfills in Atlas must be launched with the partition range and the tag atlas/backfill=true so the cost dashboard can exclude them.
